label: Hikvision 8-port smart managed 100 Mbps PoE switch (DS-3E1309P-EI)
description: Hikvision DS-3E1309P-EI - fanless metal smart-managed surveillance switch with 8x 100 Mbps PoE RJ45 ports (802.3af/at, 30 W per port, 110 W aggregate budget) and 1x gigabit RJ45 uplink. 3.6 Gbps switching capacity, 16 K MAC table, 6 kV surge protection on the PoE ports, Extend mode reaching 300 m.
notes: The port census is '8 x 100 Mbps PoE RJ45 ports, and 1 x gigabit network RJ45 port' - so eight **Fast Ethernet** PoE ports behind a **single** gigabit uplink. That asymmetry is the whole point of the part and the thing a guess gets wrong: it is a camera switch, not a gigabit switch with two speeds, and a lab that plugs a gigabit host into port 1 gets 100 Mbps. PoE figures are all quoted: 802.3af/at on ports 1-8, **30 W** maximum per port, **110 W** total budget - so four ports at 30 W exhausts the supply, and the budget is a real supply figure rather than a PSU rating. Extend mode pushes ports 1-8 to 300 m by dropping the link speed, which is a cabling-length behaviour rather than a port property, so it lives in `notes` and not in a field. Fanless, no console: management is the web/surveillance platform, hence `http-server` and no `cli`.
